mentions.name: Benchwright
mentions.description: This tool gives agentic coding tools a persistent understanding of the invariants — what must always be true about your systems — so developers don't have to constantly remind them. A cut-down local version is planned for open source.
mentions.problem: Agentic coding tools lack a persistent understanding of what must always be true about your systems, forcing constant reminders.
mentions.audience: Developers working with agentic coding tools who have to repeatedly restate system invariants.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A tool to allow your agentic coding tools understand what must always be true about your systems without having to constantly remind them.

https://benchwright.dev/
